product_one_liner.value: WellnessLiving is an all-in-one business management platform for wellness, fitness, health, and beauty businesses, combining booking, client management, payments, marketing, loyalty, reporting, and AI-powered tools.
product_one_liner.notes: WellnessLiving's company description calls it an all-in-one business-management platform serving wellness, fitness, health, and beauty businesses and names its core operational capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public pricing page that lists pricing plans and a monthly price.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: WellnessLiving's fitness-software pages identify Advantage Personal Training and REDCON1 Gym as customers. | named_customers.0: The cited page calls Advantage Personal Training a WellnessLiving customer. | named_customers.1: The cited page calls REDCON1 Gym a WellnessLiving customer.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile states the company-size band is 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The headquarters listing identifies Thornhill, Ontario, Canada; the city is Thornhill. | hq_country: The headquarters listing places WellnessLiving in Thornhill, Ontario, Canada; the country component is Canada.

founded_year.notes: The company's 2022 funding announcement says it was founded in 2013. LinkedIn gives 2012, so I use the company's press-release statement while noting the conflicting year in the supporting evidence.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents general business-growth content, product launches, customer stories, community posts, and release highlights/notes rather than an engineering or technical blog. The engineering-leader features are profile pieces, not a technical blog with two qualifying engineering build posts.

public_docs.notes: The company has a public Help Center and links to an API developer portal with documentation, endpoint references, and tutorials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company's job page lists an AI Solutions Engineer role, dated August 7, 2026, with an active Apply Now link; this is an AI-titled engineering position.

model_provider.notes: WellnessLiving's Help Center explicitly says CAASI is powered by Google Gemini.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page identifies SOC 2 audits and a SOC 2 Type 2 report, and says WellnessLiving undergoes HIPAA audits and provides HIPAA-compliant software. It discusses GDPR as a privacy law and says PCI-DSS attestations are provided by merchant-processing partners, so those are not listed as WellnessLiving certifications. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly says WellnessLiving undergoes third-party SOC 2 audits and has a SOC 2 Type 2 report. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly says WellnessLiving undergoes third-party HIPAA audits and provides HIPAA-compliant software.

value.stage: Minority growth investment (private equity plus growth financing)

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The announcement describes a minority investment together with growth financing, and Tracxn labels the latest funding round as PE; the stated stage summarizes both parts of that transaction. | funding_date: The company's funding announcement dates the $66 million transaction to August 16, 2022, which is 2022-08 at the requested granularity. | funding_amount_usd: The company's announcement reports a $46 million minority investment plus $20 million in growth financing, totaling US$66 million for the round.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile identifies the latest round as August 16, 2022, and the company's announcement gives the date and amount. That predates the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board has a Business Development Representative posting and an Enterprise Account Executive posting, both dated November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: WellnessLiving's blog announced the launch of its AI-powered Marketing Suite on August 25, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: WellnessLiving announced Don Williams as its new Chief Revenue Officer in February 2026, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A WellnessLiving business-development job post names Salesforce, and a sales-operations job post names Zoho CRM. | crm_stack_signal.0: The WellnessLiving business-development job post names Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.1: The WellnessLiving sales-operations job post names Zoho CRM.
